configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Canonical feature set for all presets. Platform/mode presets inherit and override as needed.

pm.features.FEATURE_TRIAL_CHECK: 14-day trial check (registry + %APPDATA% hidden file + HMAC). OFF for dev/internal builds.
pm.features.FEATURE_LICENSE_FILE: Offline Ed25519 license.json validation; skips trial when a valid license is present.
pm.features.FEATURE_ENCRYPT_SESSIONS: Encrypt sessions.json with a machine-derived key instead of plain JSON.
pm.features.FEATURE_PIXLWIZ_AUTH: Pixlwiz login/logout (headless OAuth child window + token store).
pm.features.FEATURE_PIXLWIZ_SHARE: Pixlwiz share post dialog (title / description / privacy / success).
pm.features.FEATURE_SESSION_VIDEO_RECORDER: Record the main window to Videos/session-HHMMSS.mp4 via WGC + H.264 (MSVC + Windows 10+ SDK). Windows-only.
pm.features.FEATURE_RAW_PREVIEW: Fast RAW thumbnail via vips_thumbnail (stage-1 preview; sub-second even for 50 MP).
pm.features.FEATURE_RAW_VIEW: Full-quality background Bayer decode via libvips (stage-2; replaces thumbnail after decode).
pm.features.FEATURE_D2D_GALLERY: D2D cover-flow filmstrip dock at the bottom of CFileViewer. Adds d2d1/dwrite/windowscodecs deps. Windows-only.
pm.features.FEATURE_STT: Mic capture + realtime STT via miniaudio (WASAPI on Windows, CoreAudio on macOS).
pm.features.FEATURE_VIDEO: Webcam / video preview capture via Media Foundation (Windows) or AVFoundation (macOS).
pm.features.FEATURE_USE_OWN_RIBBON: Win32++ CTab + hand-maintained RibbonUI.h toolbar strip. Only supported UI host (stock UIRibbon removed).
pm.features.FEATURE_SPLASH: GDI+ startup splash window (splash-1.png + logo.png). See docs/splash.md.
pm.features.FEATURE_CHAT_WEB: WebView2-hosted chat panel (apps/chat-next -> dist/shared/chat.html). Pulls Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet via FetchContent.
pm.features.FEATURE_VIEWER_WEB: WebView2 viewer dock for text/viewer-next (apps/viewer-next -> dist/shared/viewer.html). Requires FEATURE_CHAT_WEB for the WebView2 SDK.
pm.features.FEATURE_SERVE: HTTP REST API server subcommand (pm-image serve …). Includes src/http/serve.cpp and the embedded OpenAPI spec.
pm.features.FEATURE_IPC: JSON-line IPC server subcommand (pm-image ipc …). Includes src/ipc/ipc_serve.cpp.
pm.features.FEATURE_MCP_CLIENT: MCP client bridge/probe for agent mcp.json tools.
pm.features.FEATURE_HOME_LLM_TOOLS: Home/agent LLM tools bundle: built-in path tools and MCP tools.
pm.features.FEATURE_HOME_LLM_SKILLS: Home/agent LLM skills discovery and prompt injection.
pm.features.FEATURE_NODES: NodeHub graph editor dock (experimental). OFF until the node UI stabilises.
pm.features.FEATURE_XBLOX: XBlox block-flow runtime, CLI command, and Windows .xblox viewer.
pm.features.FEATURE_MODBUS_XBLOX: XBlox Modbus blocks. Requires FEATURE_XBLOX and FEATURE_MODBUS.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_PROVIDER_MODELS: CLI: provider models command (pm-image provider models …).
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_TEST: CLI: test command (pm-image test …). Win32 dev harness only.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_LICENSE: CLI: license command (pm-image license …). Win32 offline activation.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_STATUS: CLI: status command (pm-image status …). Win32 trial check only.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_REPLAY: CLI: replay command (pm-image replay …). Win32 session replay only.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_SERVE: CLI: serve command (pm-image serve …). HTTP server mode.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_IPC: CLI: ipc command (pm-image ipc …). Inter-process communication.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_AUDIO: CLI: audio command (pm-image audio …). Requires FEATURE_STT.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_VIDEO: CLI: video command (pm-image video …). Requires FEATURE_VIDEO.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_XBLOX: CLI: xblox command (pm-image xblox …). Requires FEATURE_XBLOX.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_SESSION_PERSISTENCE: CLI/UI: Save/load session commands for persistence.
pm.features.FEATURE_COMMAND_UI_COMMAND_CONTROL: UI: Run/Pause/Resume/Cancel batch control buttons in ribbon.
pm.features.FEATURE_DAEMON: Global shortcut daemon (Win32 hotkeys now; cross-platform surface).
pm.features.FEATURE_ASSISTANT: UIAutomation assistant / spy PoC (auto spy command; Win32 + UIAutomationCore.dll; see docs/win32/computer-use.md).

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: With the Visual Studio generator, build with: cmake --build --preset release --config Release (npm run build does this).

configurePresets.name: store-msi-release
configurePresets.description: Microsoft Store MSI/EXE submission track. Conservative defaults; override feature flags with -D... when invoking export-features/cmake.

configurePresets.name: clang-tidy
configurePresets.description: Runs clang-tidy on first-party targets (POLYMECH_CLANG_TIDY_BUILD). Requires llvm clang-tidy on PATH.

configurePresets.name: msvc-asan
configurePresets.description: MSVC /fsanitize=address for dev builds. Requires a Visual Studio 2022 (or later) toolset with ASan support.

configurePresets.name: release-macos
configurePresets.description: Release for macOS: binaryDir and Ninja output live on the guest local disk ($HOME/.pm-media-build), not on a VMware shared folder, so git/FetchContent and the build tree do not hit HGFS limits. FetchContent populates ~/.pm-media-fetchcontent. Source stays on the share (or a clone). See osx/README.md.

configurePresets.name: release-linux
configurePresets.description: Release for Linux: build tree lives on the guest local disk (~/.pm-media-build/linux-release) so FetchContent and Ninja do not hit HGFS/NFS latency. Source stays on the shared folder.

buildPresets.name: _build-parallel
buildPresets.description: jobs=0 → cmake --build --parallel with no count (MSBuild/Ninja use all logical CPUs).
